subject: ela
intro: Facts in a text can be connected. One thing can cause another, or things can go together in order. Kindergartners tell how two facts are connected, using words like because and so.

items.prompt:
Read.

The plant got water and sun. So it grew tall.

Why did the plant grow?

steps: I look for the connection word 'so.'
It grew BECAUSE it got water and sun.
So the plant grew because it got water and sun.
solution.answer: Because it got water and sun.

items.prompt:
Read.

It was cold. So we put on coats.

Why did we put on coats?

steps: The connection: it was cold, SO we put on coats.
We put on coats because it was cold.

items.prompt:
Read.

First you mix the batter. Then you bake the cake.

What do you do first?

steps: The order words are first and then.
So first you mix the batter.

items.prompt:
Read.

The dog was hungry, so it ate.

Why did the dog eat?

steps: It was hungry, so it ate.

items.prompt:
Read.

It rained, so the ground got wet.

Why did the ground get wet?

steps: It rained, so the ground got wet.

First we water the seed. Then it sprouts.
